scope: Corollary 2.3 (Failure comparison) of the manuscript “Critical bond and site percolation on the cubic lattice” (preprints/Critical-bond-and-site-percolation-on-the-cubic-lattice-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 213 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9c32c0ba2d3d7e3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Consider independent bond or site percolation on a finite undirected graph, with arbitrary individual probabilities in [0, 1]. For a vertex o, vertex sets A, T, and b ∈ [0, 1], if P(a ↔ T) ≥ 1 − b (a ∈ A), then P(o ↔ A, o ̸↔ T) ≤ b. (2.8) The assertion therefore applies after any deterministic collection of bits has been fixed.
